Marcus / Kimberly —

Thanks for the note and the cert. I reviewed the Order Form RF-7823 clauses. High-level: the cert alone is not sufficient for acceptance; we need either (a) a formal Additional Insured endorsement attached to the certificate verifying the exact wording, or (b) a carrier letter referencing the endorsement number and confirming it will be issued. Carrier-provided endorsement is acceptable if it contains the required language and limits.

Suggested endorsement text to request from the carrier (carrier-friendly but protective):

"It is hereby understood and agreed that Underwriters Inc. extends coverage to \"NimbusCloud, Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates\" as Additional Insureds with respect to liability arising out of the operations of Redwood Inference performed on behalf of NimbusCloud. This endorsement shall be primary and noncontributory as to any other insurance available to the Additional Insureds, but only with respect to liability arising out of Redwood Inference's operations under Order Form RF-7823. The insurer waives rights of subrogation against NimbusCloud, Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates.

Limits: No less than $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate.

Endorsement date: must be effective on or before the Order Form execution date. No retroactive date that would exclude occurrences during the policy term is acceptable.

Additional asks: please provide the endorsement document (PDF) and a point-of-contact email at the carrier for verification; we prefer the carrier to add the endorsement rather than a broker-only statement.

I'm attaching a short redline template for the endorsement and an example clause we typically accept (redline_endorsement_template.docx).

If Kimberly prefers, we can permit countersignature with a carrier confirmation milestone: carrier to deliver endorsement within 7 business days of countersign and provide certificate + endorsement to Redwood and Nimbus; however, Nimbus may insist on the endorsement prior to countersign — you'll need to confirm their posture."
